name: Ally Accessibility Suite
promise: Find, explain, repair, teach, and track accessibility without overstating evidence.
completion_criteria: A11yFinding round-trips across audit, learning, ticket, and browser surfaces without evidence loss.
WCAG Auditor unique rules and crawl behavior are ported or explicitly rejected with parity evidence.
One keyboard overlay remains after file, feature, permission, and runtime parity review.
Automated, AI-assisted, and manual assistive-technology evidence remain visibly distinct.

supporting_evidence.reason: Input case table read by the A1 parity adapter at adapters/accessibility.py; not a receipt.
Human-readable projection of the canonical A2-WCAG-331-EVIDENCE.json receipt.
Superseded 2026-08-20 narrative. Its consolidation and permission claims were never executed; A3-KEYBOARD-OVERLAY-RECONCILIATION.json is canonical.

waves.objective: Create the WCAG Auditor to Ally rule, crawl, finding, and deliverable parity matrix.
waves.runtime_followup: Execute the parity matrix's port decisions against the real allys-tools runtime so each ported behavior carries donor-vs-destination output parity rather than a decision record.
waves.acceptance: Every unique behavior has an owner, fixture, and port or reject decision.

waves.objective: Port one unique deterministic rule end to end through A11yFinding and full-audit evidence.
waves.acceptance: Focused and full-suite gates pass and the manifest proves authentic donor and destination invocation, output and failure parity, provenance, and rerun safety.

waves.objective: Reconcile three keyboard overlays through source, manifest, permissions, and feature inventory.
waves.runtime_followup: Load the canonical kb-overlay anchor in a real browser and verify the reconciled feature inventory behaves as the matrix declares, rather than as the manifests declare.
waves.acceptance: Source inventory, manifest structure, permissions, and feature comparative analysis support the canonical anchor selection.

waves.objective: Evaluate remaining heuristic and narrow WCAG Auditor rule candidates for later ports.
waves.acceptance: Live donor AST inspection classifies 20 candidates, suite-local A11yFinding projections validate, and the compliant-markup smoke probe has zero findings; neither runtime is invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Port candidate rules into the real allys-tools TypeScript runtime and execute authentic donor vs destination parity tests against representative HTML inputs.

waves.objective: Project A11yFinding through a suite-local teaching view shaped for A11y Kitchen.
waves.acceptance: The suite-local learner projection preserves every canonical finding field and explicitly records that the A11y Kitchen runtime was not invoked.
waves.runtime_followup: Ingest live findings produced by the real allys-tools scanner directly into the running A11y Kitchen web application and verify interactive render parity.

waves.objective: Measure the keyboard-overlay permission surface and prepare a consolidation proposal.
waves.acceptance: The proposal compares all three sources, records the broad host scope, and leaves permission minimization, runtime acceptance, donor freeze, and retirement explicitly outstanding.
waves.runtime_followup: Narrow the canonical content-script host scope below <all_urls>, then the owner freezes the two superseded donor repositories; this gate performs neither.
